## Resolved by removing the commit that carried it. No code change was needed.

The shared main checkout has been reset to `origin/main` at `e900fa14ad5`. The unpushed bypass
commit `7b92d821718` — the sole carrier of this defect, superseded in content by merged change
2977 — is preserved on local branch `salvage/7b92-worktree-default-bypass` and is off main.

### Verification after the reset

The `Makefile` in the shared checkout now has no `@#` comment on any continuation line inside the
`worktree` recipe:

```
continuation-comment defects: NONE
```

and its usage text reads `default .rebar/worktrees/<branch>`, matching the adopted convention and
the 12 worktrees that actually exist.

`make worktree` was already proven functional from an `origin/main` tree earlier on this ticket: it
fetched, created the worktree, and provisioned the venv with CPython 3.12.14 and 116 packages.

### What was NOT lost

The checkout's working tree showed `.mcp.json` as modified before the reset. That modification was
relative to `7b92d821718`, which predates the Serena configuration block; `e900fa14ad5` already
contains that block, so the reset moved the file to the state it was already in. The Serena entry is
intact. No untracked file was touched.

### Disposition

Closing as not-a-defect against the merged tree. The planned `Makefile`, `AGENTS.md` and
`CONTRIBUTING.md` edits in this ticket's `file_impact` are withdrawn: the merged `Makefile` does not
carry the defect, and rejoining `set -e` is unnecessary because it is already joined to the recipe
body on `origin/main`, so Bug 1738's protection was never detached there.

No plan review and no remediation change were spent on this.
